primary.selection: Frozen ordinary no-sound visual PP expert; no sound encoder or aim assistance.

assets.scenario: Both environments load the identical installed ViZDoom 1.3.0 predict_position.cfg and scenario WAD; standard reward and terminal rules apply to both.

expert_render.resize: Nearest 128x72 CHW; saved input normalization; GRU reset per episode

student_observation: Unmodified UnifiedDoomEnv 320x240 visible-label/player structured state with history_length=4 and installed new Freedoom materials. Expert pixels, hidden state and actions are never inserted into the student observation.

splits.in_distribution: Distinct seeds; frame_skip=4, max_steps=75; native timeout also applies.
splits.ood: Distinct seeds; frame_skip=8, max_steps=38. The expert advances its GRU once per decision and repeats the selected action for up to eight real ticks. Decision cadence shift; OOD does not select models.
splits.latent_group: shooting hash of scenario and seed; one distinct seed per episode across all splits.
splits.observation_aliasing: Different latent seeds can yield equal visible observations. This is allowed and does not create shared latent groups.

retention: Every executed state from all complete selected episodes, including failures and zero-ammo states. Subsequent preparation may retain only pre-action observed ammo > 0 for policy supervision.

collection.ordered_output: Registered case order, independent CPU actors and RNN state; exact tick mirror and independent standard-only replay required.
